fidelity: Real bootstrapCourse and seedThirteenCrewCourse create the fixture through production typed persistence APIs.
Capture includes the actual SQLite IDBBatchAtomicVFS blocks/metadata stores via Playwright storageState({indexedDB:true}); no schema or storage substitution.

Two fresh browser contexts restore the same in-memory snapshot. Clone A changes one initial note through the visible UI and retains valid structure; clone B restores every course-table/meta row with exact IDs, values and timestamps before any editing action.
Both clones display the roster and 13-crew summary; clone B shows the original note. Stored-row and domain invariants are empty.
JSON serialization of the supplied snapshot object is unchanged after both clones.

limits: This validates the pinned Playwright/runtime combination, not every platform or release.
No cache/reuse implementation is yet in the suite; any later use is restricted to setup for repeated layout fixtures, retaining cold/migration/reopen/reset/update behavior unchanged.
Timings include UI proof and are diagnostic only; they do not establish the >=30% T1 acceptance target.
No explicit storage-state file is written or committed. Framework diagnostic traces remain in OS temporary folders and can contain synthetic records.

setStorageStateProof.method: Restore a structuredClone into a standard fresh context with its only page still about:blank, then normal app mount; both clones compare every table/meta row before UI actions and retain all earlier isolation/UI assertions.
